Embroidery & technique

Everything is worked by hand in Anchor threads on linen. Ten techniques in three families: what we do with thread, what we do to the linen itself, and what we layer on. Tap any image to see it close.

  • Cross-stitch
  • Running stitch
  • Satin-stitch florals
  • French knots
  • Pintucks
  • Folded waves
  • Lattice smocking
  • Smocked cuffs
  • Raw-edged appliqué
  • Lace insertion
Thread

Stitch as drawing

Pattern made with the needle alone, from tiny crossed stitches and packed knots to smooth, painted fills.

Structure

Shaping the linen

Texture built into the fabric itself: folded, gathered and stitched down, usually in the same colour.

Layering

Appliqués and layering fabrics

Cut fabric and lace, stitched onto or set into the garment for depth and softness.
